thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-09-14 leads with 'Nasdaq futures slide as AI warnings rattle markets; Nvidia, other chip stocks retreat' and a UBS CEO warning about investor complacency amid rising geopolitical/economic risk. This is real but concentrated in tech/AI names rather than the broad, diversified VTI sleeve, and a caution flag isn't grounds to trim a small core holding. The rest of the pack is a heavy run of single-name 'Jim Cramer says' commentary, dividend-stock listicles, and routine politician PTR filings -- none actionable for a conservative core-ETF mandate. Existing VTI position (~22.6 of ~107.6 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than reacting to sector-specific headline risk, consistent with capital preservation.
